decisions: This is implementation attempt 8, resolving review cycle 5's fix request (worktrees/MEMORIES-0003/.ai/input/fix-request-review-5.md), which had 1 major finding: a repository-wide brand scan still matched the old prototype brand name (acceptance criterion 18's prohibited spelling) in task-created source/documentation.

Finding: packages/design-system/src/tokens.css:45 had a doc comment attributing the --memories-* raw palette's origin to the old brand name, and docs/prototype-inventory.md had 3 prose references naming actual legacy-branded prototype filenames (a superseded logo asset in the dat-lam-rieng row, and the tao-thiep editor's legacy JS engine file, named twice).

Fixed by rewording all 4 matches to describe the same provenance/attribution (rebranded from / ported from the prototypes' pre-existing legacy brand) without spelling the old brand name -- no token values, filenames, code, routes or tests changed.

Re-scanning afterwards found the same pattern in 2 more task-created deliverables not named by the fix request: worktrees/MEMORIES-0003/.ai/validation/skills/acceptance-evidence.json's design-foundation evidence text, and this task's own prior ai/tasks/MEMORIES-0003/implementation.json (summary, one decision, one acceptance-criterion evidence string, one applied_skills bullet). All were reworded the same way.

A repository-wide case-insensitive scan for the old brand name across the frontend worktree and .ai/validation now returns zero matches, excluding prototype/ itself (task.md forbids modifying prototype source) and past session-exchange transcripts/fix-request documents (logs/inputs, not task-created deliverables).

Regenerated summary.json, frontend.json, delivery-gates.json (timestamps only -- command outputs re-verified unchanged) and ai/tasks/MEMORIES-0003/implementation.json (rebranding fix plus new decision/validation/applied_skills entries for this cycle) so every evidence file agrees with the current, re-verified state. No other slices/files were touched this cycle.
